answer: Anyone running 50 aliases thus needs 178 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in bridge, expire in atlas, and knoll lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1212 identities would post 3997 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
